name: @pretable-internal/renderer-dom
description: Internal DOM renderer planning layer for Pretable.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pretable-internal/text-core build && pnpm --filter @pretable-internal/layout-core build && pnpm --filter @pretable/core build && tsc -b
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @pretable-internal/text-core build && pnpm --filter @pretable-internal/layout-core build && pnpm --filter @pretable/core build && vitest run --passWithNoTests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @pretable-internal/text-core build && pnpm --filter @pretable-internal/layout-core build && pnpm --filter @pretable/core build && tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.typecheck.json --noEmit --pretty false
